focus: Cross-check the newest CFTC August 2026 FCM panel against Ripple Prime's October 20 daily customer-segregation filing and Ripple's month-end net-capital disclosure; compare Hidden Road and Coinbase Financial Markets without conflating legal entities or customer funds; resolve Japan SBIC and the exact ChatGPT event.

findings.claim: CFTC August 31 2026 data report Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC adjusted net capital $968.424304M, customer assets in 4d(a)(2) segregation $720.132M, required segregation $657.476M and excess $62.656M. This is a legal-entity FCM measure and not XRP collateral.

CFTC August 31 2026 data report Coinbase Financial Markets Inc. adjusted net capital $321.159M, 4d(a)(2) customer assets $346.894M, separate Part 30 assets $6.006M and cleared-swap customer assets $166.135M. These separate statutory account categories are not Coinbase Global consolidated capital or XRP exposure.

Hidden Road's October 20 daily segregation statement reports $667.976M in customer segregation against $602.617M required, excess $65.359M, including $633.790M cash margins on deposit with DCOs. The filing does not identify token/asset composition and is not proof of XRP collateral.

Ripple's August 2026 month-end net-capital history reports adjusted net capital $968.424305M, agreeing with the CFTC August figure within $1. Its 'minimum net capital requirement' differs from the CFTC report's greater-of net-capital requirement and must not be conflated.

Hidden Road's adjusted net capital rose 32.41% and 4d(a)(2) customer segregated assets rose 12.04% from July to August. This indicates a larger reported FCM capital/customer-funds footprint, but does not identify XRP balances, Bitnomial postings or incremental spot buying.

Coinbase Financial Markets' reported customer assets across 4d(a)(2), Part 30 and cleared swaps rose 16.60% from July to August when those distinct account categories are summed as a reporting aggregate. The account pools are not fungible and do not establish XRP collateral or Coinbase Global cash.

Japan's SBIC candidate is Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC East Japan), corporate number 9011001030621, established 1963; its official profile lists local governments, chambers of commerce, financial institutions and operating companies among shareholders.

SBIC East Japan organized a March 5 2026 ChatGPT/Generative AI seminar, co-hosted by Hamamatsu Iwata Shinkin, with a Microsoft Japan speaker and ChatGPT demonstration. This is education, not proof of an OpenAI partnership or XRP relationship.

SBIC East Japan reported five new investments and five reinvestments totaling ¥213.87M in September 2026. The announcement describes Japanese SME investments, not XRP/Ripple/SBI Holdings or OpenAI investment.

actual_capital_taxonomy.adjusted_net_capital: FCM regulatory capital after applicable adjustments/haircuts.
actual_capital_taxonomy.customer_segregated_funds: Customer money, securities and property held in statutory segregated accounts; not firm equity or token-level XRP.
actual_capital_taxonomy.dco_margin: Customer margin posted at derivatives clearing organizations; daily statement identifies cash amount but not token composition.
actual_capital_taxonomy.matched_book_repo: Traditional secured financing assets/liabilities; not free cash or XRP inventory.
actual_capital_taxonomy.parent_capital_contributions: Equity support to the FCM; not customer collateral or spot purchases.
actual_capital_taxonomy.xrp_collateral: Asset-specific XRP posted/held by a named counterparty; not disclosed in these CFTC aggregate filings.
actual_capital_taxonomy.actual_market_capital_flow: Net external cash/asset flow into spot or institutional XRP exposure; not measured by these FCM filings.

competing_hypotheses_summary.claim: Hidden Road's rising regulatory capital and customer funds indicate greater reported FCM scale/capacity, not proven XRP collateral or spot demand.
competing_hypotheses_summary.counter_evidence: Asset-level token composition and Bitnomial customer posting are not disclosed; October 20 daily segregation is below August month-end.

competing_hypotheses_summary.claim: October 20 daily customer segregation demonstrates that FCM customer-fund balances fluctuate and cannot be extrapolated monotonically from one month-end snapshot.
competing_hypotheses_summary.counter_evidence: The daily statement is a single date and not a complete daily time series.

competing_hypotheses_summary.claim: Coinbase Financial Markets' FCM customer-fund growth reflects derivatives/customer account activity but not XRP-specific collateral or Coinbase Global cash.
competing_hypotheses_summary.counter_evidence: Product mix could include crypto-linked derivatives, but asset-level collateral composition is not disclosed.

competing_hypotheses_summary.claim: The named Ripple Prime FCM clearing-member relationship and Bitnomial's XRP collateral acceptance create a possible institutional route, but actual XRP use by Ripple Prime customers remains unknown.
competing_hypotheses_summary.counter_evidence: No public FCM notice/reliance date, customer XRP balance, Bitnomial posting or asset-level margin record has been verified.

competing_hypotheses_summary.claim: SBIC East Japan's ChatGPT event is educational programming and does not imply an OpenAI partnership, SBI Holdings relationship or XRP investment.
competing_hypotheses_summary.counter_evidence: The reviewed official event page names Microsoft as the speaker organization; no commercial partnership or XRP activity is stated.

competing_hypotheses_summary.claim: FCM adjusted net capital, segregated customer funds, DCO margin, repo financing, parent capital, token-level collateral and spot-market flows must be separate model variables.
competing_hypotheses_summary.counter_evidence: These measures may interact economically, but the available filings do not establish a direct conversion or causal identity between them.
